title: ai relay must not print the legacy roles advice before failing on an unreadable matrix
lead: When `.slicer/relay-roles.json` is a directory and a leftover `.slicer/relay-roles.md` is present, `ai relay` prints the `legacy_relay_roles` advice on stderr and then fails with `io`. `cmd_ai_relay` (cli.py:397-400) prints the advice before `store.read_roles` raises. The advice then names `relay-roles init --replace-legacy`, which fails with the same `io` error. `ai relay` should read the matrix first, so the `io` error is the only thing it reports.
findings_note: s261 relay, 2026-10-13: with a directory at .slicer/relay-roles.json and a leftover relay-roles.md, ai relay prints the legacy_relay_roles advice on stderr and then fails with io
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing `read_roles`, `roles_init` or `check`. `check` already stops on the `io` error. Also out of scope: the existence test on the JSON path inside `legacy_roles_advice`, and any other legacy-file handling.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s261's implementer reproduced this in a scratch repo, and the s261 reviewer confirmed it by reading the code. It was outside s261's boundary. Advice printed just before a failure sends the owner to a command that cannot succeed.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- With a directory at `.slicer/relay-roles.json` and a file at `.slicer/relay-roles.md`, `ai relay` exits 3 with `io`, and stderr does not contain `legacy_relay_roles`.
- With a readable matrix and a leftover `.md` file, `ai relay` still prints the advice on stderr and exits 0. That behaviour is unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `cmd_ai_relay`, call `store.read_roles(project)` before `store.legacy_roles_advice(project)`, and print the advice only after the read succeeds.
2. Add the tests and a CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The full suite passes on Python 3.11+.
- `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s266`, branch `feature/s266-ai-relay-advice-order`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
